title:
Calls {@link ReliabilityAsset#assignToProject} to add the given projects to the asset.

Expected payload:
- `assetId` (`string` | {@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpecParam}): The id of the asset to which the projects will be added.
- `projectId` (`string` | {@link UiSdlDynamicValueSpecParam}): The id of the project to add to the asset.
- `spinnerId` (`string`): The id of the spinner to show while the request is in progress.
- `modalId` (`string`): The id of the modal to close after the request is complete.
name: AddProjectToAssetEpic
